name: LiSSARA Core
description: Mathematical Reconstruction of Illustrations Dedicated to Cute Anime Girls
info:
LiSSARA Core v0.1.0
Mathematical Reconstruction of Illustrations Dedicated to Cute Anime Girls.

Install:
  emtypyie /get lissara

Run:
  emtypyie /run lissara

The installer clones https://github.com/emtypyie/LiSSARA, installs the
Python dependencies into the local Emtypyie runtime, and builds a standalone
desktop executable with PyInstaller.

Docs:   https://github.com/emtypyie/LiSSARA#readme
Issues: https://github.com/emtypyie/LiSSARA/issues
